service.method: SELECT DEPLOY_ID, SERVER_URL, DESCRIPTION, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID FROM SDPGL ORDER BY DEPLOY_ID

SELECT DEPLOY_ID, SERVER_URL, DESCRIPTION, SOURCE_TEMP_DIR, TARGET_TEMP_DIR, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID FROM SDPGL WHERE DEPLOY_ID = ${DEPLOY_ID} ORDER BY DEPLOY_ID

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '*' AS TREE_PARENT_ID, MODULE_NAME AS TREE_ID, '' AS MODULE_NAME, MODULE_NAME AS MODULE_NAME_TMP, SOURCE_BASE_DIR AS "FROM", TARGET_BASE_DIR AS "TO", '' AS INCLUDE, '' AS EXCLUDE, USE_YN, '0' AS SEQ, '' AS SCRIPT FROM SDPLN WHERE DEPLOY_ID = ${DEPLOY_ID} ORDER BY TO_NUMBER("ORDER")) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DPLN.MODULE_NAME AS TREE_PARENT_ID, DPLN.MODULE_NAME || DPSE."ORDER" AS TREE_ID, '' AS MODULE_NAME, DPSE.MODULE_NAME AS MODULE_NAME_TMP, DPSE."FROM", DPSE."TO", DPSE.INCLUDE, DPSE.EXCLUDE, DPSE.USE_YN, SEQ, DPSE.SCRIPT FROM SDPLN DPLN, SDPSE DPSE WHERE DPLN.DEPLOY_ID = ${DEPLOY_ID} AND DPLN.DEPLOY_ID = DPSE.DEPLOY_ID AND DPLN.MODULE_NAME = DPSE.MODULE_NAME ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(DPLN."ORDER"), TO_NUMBER(DPSE."ORDER"))
